subject: infra.energy
name: Power sequencing plan for the data-localisation deadline
what_would_settle_it: A CBN, NITDA or Ministry of Power statement sequencing grid and data-centre capacity milestones against the 2027-01-01 localisation deadline.
disposition: absence stands, dated — operators assert readiness for the deadline, and no government instrument sequences grid milestones against it

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Public breach disclosure regime
what_would_settle_it: An NDPC or NCC rule requiring breach notifications to be published, or an annual register of notified breaches naming the controllers involved.
disposition: absence stands, dated — 72-hour notification to the Commission is required and no published register of notified breaches exists

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Published interoperability framework under the NIMC Act 2026
what_would_settle_it: A gazetted regulation or published framework stating the lawful basis, consent mechanism, retention rule and audit arrangements for inter-agency sharing of identity data — or the gazetted text of the Act itself.
disposition: acquisition line — the gazetted NIMC Act 2026; the Commission says implementing regulations will issue in due course

subject: gov.standards
name: Whether foreign cloud local zones satisfy the localisation directive
what_would_settle_it: A CBN clarification, FAQ or supervisory letter stating whether a hyperscaler's in-country availability zone meets the storage-and-management requirement of circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004.
disposition: absence stands, dated — named in the compliance analysis as the open question the circular does not answer

subject: finance.budget
name: Consolidated federal budget allocation to digital transformation
what_would_settle_it: A Budget Office appropriation extract or Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy annual report carrying total digital and ICT spend across votes.
disposition: acquisition line — the 2026 Appropriation Bill, which carries the digital-economy ministry allocation

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Proposed responsible-AI governance framework for public bodies
what_would_settle_it: The instrument, terms of reference or ministerial statement establishing the proposed responsible-AI governance framework for public institutions.

subject: gov.regional
name: Malabo Convention ratification position
what_would_settle_it: An instrument of signature, ratification or accession to the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection, or an official statement of the government's position on it.
disposition: absence stands, dated - a peer-reviewed review of four countries' health-data governance records only Rwanda as a signatory

subject: tech.ai
name: Rules governing automated decisions in hiring
what_would_settle_it: a statute, labour-code provision, data-protection guidance note or regulator determination naming automated or algorithmic decisions in recruitment would settle it; probed 2026-09-08, a four-country comparative legal review finds none in the constitution, the labour code or the data-protection act

subject: gov.protect
name: Coordinated framework for digital-ecosystem complaints
what_would_settle_it: A published framework, terms of reference or memorandum naming a lead body and a referral route for digital-ecosystem complaints, or a commission statement that one has been adopted.
disposition: absence stands, dated - the human rights commission itself states the gap and calls for a framework; nothing held names one

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A Budget Office implementation report or audited federal accounts giving actual spending against the 2024-2026 appropriations of the identity commission, the communications ministry and the other digital lines.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Payment terms of the Smart National Transport Databank concession
what_would_settle_it: The ICRC concession summary or full business case stating how Asia-Arab Investment Nigeria Limited is paid (user charges, availability payments or revenue share) and what the state owes over the 20 years.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Terms of Galaxy Backbone's technical partnership with Huawei
what_would_settle_it: A published agreement or disclosure stating the data jurisdiction, portability, exit and audit terms of Galaxy Backbone's partnership with Huawei.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Where the national identity database is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A NIMC, NITDA or World Bank ID4D document stating where the identity database and NIMS 2.0 are hosted, who holds the keys and administrative access, and under whose jurisdiction.
